data.name: Saarvik
data.gender_notes: Saarvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saarvik is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Saarva', which means 'all' or 'whole'. The suffix 'ik' denotes 'lord' or 'ruler'. Saarvik is thus the lord or ruler of the entire sky. In Hindu mythology, Saarvik is the name of the god Indra, the deity of the sky and rain. The name Saarvik carries the meaning “Lord of the sky” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Saarvik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Saarvik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saarvik total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
